summary:
Mars Survival is an educational survival simulation project developed using Roblox Studio. The project explores the challenges of establishing and maintaining human life on Mars through an interactive virtual environment.

Players are required to manage essential resources such as food and water, explore the Martian landscape, and develop sustainable farming systems. The game aims to introduce the scientific, technological and environmental challenges associated with future human exploration of Mars.

By combining game-based learning, programming and AI-assisted development, this project transforms complex space exploration concepts into an interactive learning experience.
details:
Background

  • Mars has an extremely harsh environment compared to Earth.
  • The planet has a thin atmosphere and very low temperatures.
  • Liquid water is difficult to maintain on the Martian surface.
  • Long-term human survival requires reliable life-support systems.

Problem Statement

Human exploration of Mars faces several major challenges, including limited water availability, food production, environmental conditions and resource sustainability. Understanding these challenges is essential when planning future human missions to Mars.

Objective

Description

Resource Management

Simulate the management of food and water

Sustainable Farming

Demonstrate basic crop cultivation

Survival Simulation

Introduce resource-dependent survival

Space Education

Teach challenges of living on Mars

Interactive Learning

Allow players to learn through gameplay

4.1 Core Game Systems

A. Survival Resource Management System

Purpose: Simulate the importance of managing limited resources on Mars.

Technical explanation:

  • Food and water are represented by resource values.
  • The HUD displays the player's current resource levels.
  • Players interact with food and water items.
  • Resource values should update when players consume supplies.

B. Farming and Agriculture System

Purpose: Demonstrate how food could potentially be produced in a controlled Martian environment.

Technical explanation:

  • Players obtain seeds.
  • Seeds can be placed on designated farming land.
  • The farming system represents the crop cultivation process.
  • Future development can introduce growth stages and harvesting.

C. Mars Exploration Environment

Purpose: Provide an environment where players can explore a simulated Martian settlement.

Technical explanation:

  • A virtual Martian landscape.
  • Player spawning area.
  • Resource storage area.
  • Designated farming area.

AI Integration Statement

ChatGPT was used as an AI-assisted development tool throughout the project. It supported the development team in generating programming examples, understanding Luau scripting, troubleshooting technical problems and refining game mechanics.AI-generated code was treated as development assistance rather than a finished solution. The team was responsible for integrating, testing and evaluating the scripts within Roblox Studio.

9. Development Methodology

  1. Concept Development: Identify the challenges of human survival on Mars.
  2. System Planning: Define the survival mechanics and game features.
  3. Environment Development: Build the Martian environment in Roblox Studio.
  4. Programming & Integration: Develop and integrate the game systems.
  5. Testing & Evaluation: Test interactions, identify bugs and improve functionality.

12. Conclusion

Mars Survival demonstrates how interactive game development can be used to introduce the challenges of future human exploration on Mars. Through programming, resource management and simulated agriculture, the project provides an educational environment where players can explore the fundamental requirements of sustaining human life beyond Earth. Our project represents an initial step towards understanding the technological and environmental challenges of future Mars exploration.
